_comment: Read by scripts/instance-templates.py. `optional`: instance files the core reads that need no template in templates/rules-instance/, each with the reason measured at its reader (2026-10-30). A brain looking for what it MAY add reads this list. `unclassified`: a shrink-only ratchet for gaps not yet judged - a name may leave it, never join it.

optional.backprop.json: backprop-report.py: rule files and search paths; missing file = built-in defaults that fit a brain
optional.brain-scan-prep.json: brain-scan-prep.py: decided/dropped words in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.class-gate.json: class-gate.cjs: level_patterns in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.dead-carriers.json: dead-carriers.py: absence_patterns in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.freshness-gate.json: freshness-gate.cjs: per-brain thresholds; missing file = built-in defaults (14 days)
optional.friction-accepted.json: brain-friction.py: accepted frictions with reasons; missing file = nothing accepted, every friction reported
optional.gate-answer-markers.json: gate-precision.py: extra answer markers; missing file = built-in markers
optional.leak-names.json: leak-scan.py, public-text-guard.cjs and others: the template lives at templates/leak-names.json, copied by bootstrap-brain.sh
optional.loop-watchdog.json: loop-watchdog.sh: the repo an alarm outside a session opens its issue in; missing file = no issue opened, the alarm still reaches the next start report
optional.manual-tools.json: brain-friction.py, brain-selftest.sh, local-machinery.py: hand tools a brain runs on purpose; missing file = none declared
optional.no-input-control.json: no-input-control.cjs: extra patterns and allows with reasons; missing file is the normal case
optional.open-items.json: open-items-gate.cjs, autonomous-mode.cjs and others: the instance's language (`<key>_patterns`, generic_words) and its waiting map; missing file = English built-ins, no waits
optional.orphan-check.json: orphan-check.py: extra process paths and allows with reasons; missing file = built-ins only
optional.premise-patterns.json: premise-gate.cjs: generalisation/instruction patterns in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.promise-patterns.json: promise-gate.cjs: commitment/condition patterns in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.secret-patterns.json: secret-guard.cjs: extra file/bash patterns; missing file is the normal case, a broken one never widens the guard
optional.shared-memory-post.json: shared-memory-post.py: check_words in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.skill-placement.json: skill-lint.py: opt-in placement ratchet; missing file = placement check off, provenance only for drafts (by design)
optional.stop-patterns.json: stoppen-gate.cjs: stop patterns in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
optional.watch-gate.json: watch-gate.cjs, done-claim.cjs, verification-gate.cjs: hand-step/done-claim words in the instance's language; missing file = English built-ins
